CASTELLANE, 9 February (Meridian Brief) — Northwind Regional is opening a hub at Castellane Airfield, people familiar with the matter said.

Marguerite Ostrand, the airline's Chief Operating Officer, announced the hub at a press conference today. The move rests on a signed Hub Operating Agreement with the Castellane Airfield Authority, which was unveiled at the same event.

The hub opens on 14 April 2026, with the first scheduled departures that morning. It will start with 38 weekly departures and is expected to create about 420 local jobs, according to the people familiar.

Northwind Regional has not detailed which routes will launch first. The Castellane Airfield Authority has not said whether further agreements are planned.

The announcement ends months of speculation over which carrier would anchor operations at the airfield.
